verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API with Bearer/OAuth2 authentication for reading/writing content (docs-18, docs-33) and an MCP integration path, but the MCP docs describe building a custom MCP *client* rather than shipping an official SDK, and probes found no OpenAPI spec exposed (404s across all candidate paths). There's no evidence of official language SDKs (Python, JS, etc.) or SDK code samples/libraries beyond the raw REST endpoints. missing for 10: official SDK packages in common languages, discoverable OpenAPI/schema definitions, independent developer corroboration of building against the API/SDK.
